content.text:
All three sizes are rendered and verified.

**Files in the folder:** `flyer.html` (single scalable source), `portrait.png` 1080×1350, `wide.png` 1200×1000, `sky.png` 300×600.

**How it works:** one HTML file takes `?w&h&s`; `s` sets `html{font-size:calc(100px * var(--s))}` and every dimension is in `rem`, so all content scales exactly 1× / 0.85× / 0.28× off the portrait master. The flyer is a flex column: headline, photo band, candidate row, red CTA bar, steps, footer, with two flexible spacers and a flex-growing photo so the vertical slack (large in the tall sky unit, negative in the short wide unit) is absorbed by the hero image and whitespace rather than by cramming text.

**Defects found and fixed during checking:**
- Photo dominated the sky unit (67% of height) — added weighted spacers so slack splits between image and breathing room.
- `VOTE BY MAIL` had `line-height:1`, so its line box was 4px shorter than the glyph box (clipping risk) — bumped to 1.15.
- Candidate columns differed by 1px because the divider border consumed column width — dividers are now absolutely positioned pseudo-elements, so the three columns are exactly equal (333.33 / 377.33 / 92.5px).

**Automated verification on all three sizes:** zero elements out of the flyer bounds, zero horizontal or vertical content overflow, bands measured at full container width (1080/1200/300), photo uses `object-fit:cover` (crops, never distorts — natural 1600×1000 into varying band ratios), and the written PNG headers report exactly 1080×1350, 1200×1000, 300×600.
